capability_assessments.rationale: Full paper concerns AutoML model development, general predictive models and a claimed retail pilot. It defines no own health-world state-transition model. Search iterations/training epochs are not world-time transitions; citations do not transfer world-model features.

gate_assessments.rationale: For the claimed empirical comparison, no identifiable dataset, sample, split/fit protocol or traceable provenance is supplied. Generic preprocessing/CV advice is not a completed audit.

legacy_cells.I: 004_2025_The Emergence of Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) Trends and Future Prospects.pdf
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–14: title page, abstract, Introduction, Methods, Results (including Tables 1 and relevant figure descriptions), Discussion, constraints/limitations, future directions, and final considerations; PDF pp. 15–19: references. Reviewed the complete extracted text; Table 1 was readable in the text extraction. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: This is a broad AutoML review, not a healthcare-focused study; healthcare appears as general context, while the stated pilot is retail. No healthcare state-transition/action model is evaluated, so it is excluded as non-healthcare rather than treated as a world-model component. No unreadable-table issue encountered. Evidence QA: 4/4 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (100%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 4 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: All 19 physical PDF pages were read as extracted text, including all 43 references. All 19 pages were rendered; pages 1, 2, 8, 9, 11, 12 and 17 were visually inspected, covering all three actual figures and the sole table. No appendix or supplement is included in this PDF.

Table 1 values are preserved in source evidence, PaperVersion properties and the E14 assessment. No MetricResult/ModelVersion nodes are fabricated because comparator configurations, datasets and model identities are not specified.

Claims of systematic review methods and retail experimentation lack reconstructable protocols. Figure/caption inconsistencies and editorial residues are source flags, not a finding that results were fabricated.

Cited papers, external links, datasets and code were not retrieved or independently verified. No clinical use/readiness, calibrated probabilities, causal identification or benchmark comparability is inferred.
One model extraction with a skeptical second reading; no independent human review or experimental replication. Normalized quotation occurrence is not entailment.
notes: Excluded non-healthcare AutoML review with under-specified empirical claims. No fallback BP_COMPONENT, healthcare world type, R0 or clinical readiness is invented for an excluded record. Generic component descriptions stay at claim/specification stage with their attribution. Article CC BY license is not assigned to unspecified model artifacts.
